tier_rule: DEVELOPMENT unless a GMI_K5_BH_EXECUTION_FREEZE_V8.json and GMI_K5_BH_PUBLIC_BEACON_V8.json exist and verify; development receipts are never protected evidence and are written under microscopes/results/k5_bh_v8_dev/.

experiment_core.note: The core's own predicted_winner and prediction_margin are recorded in every receipt but are NOT scored. V8 predictions are the per-cell entries below; the V8 margin is recomputed from the receipt observables (objective of the alternative minus objective of the V8-predicted winner).

scoring.cell_rule: GMI_K5_BH_SCORING_FREEZE_V1.json stochastic rule (>=6/8 agreement AND mean-margin sign) with GMI_K5_BH_ADMISSIBILITY_SCORING_ADDENDUM_V2.json (any predicted-inadmissible replicate -> INCONCLUSIVE; >=6 -> THEORY_RED); numerical quality thresholds unchanged (C max test error 0.18, E min normalized return 0.80).
scoring.lane_rule: A lane is GREEN only if all four lane cells are GREEN; probe cells never enter the lane verdict.
scoring.probe_rule: A probe cell is scored only against its numbered predictions; a predicted winner NONE agrees iff observed_winner is NONE.

C_FEATURE_LEARNING.corrected_law: TRAINABLE_FEATURE wins iff both realizations are admissible and the protected-error gain of the developed trainable realization over the fixed realization, in percentage points, exceeds the frozen price surplus delta(s) = 0.94 + 0.01*feature_movement (0.98 at V7 movements). Under the frozen development D7 (hidden 6, 320 full-batch steps, lr 0.25, init +-0.15) the gain is 0 within noise for s <= 0.6 (V7: -0.09 pp, 0/8 exceed delta) and +1.27 pp at s = 1.0 (4/8 exceed delta); the crossover therefore lies in (0.85, 1.0] and coincides with the fixed-feature admissibility cliff (linear-Bayes floor 0.170 at s = 1.0). No s in [0, 1.2] yields a TRAINABLE_FEATURE cell that is both admissible and winning in >= 6/8 replicates under D7.

numbered_predictions.P-C5: fixed realization inadmissible (test error > 0.18) in >= 6/8 replicates

C_FEATURE_LEARNING.world_check: P-C4: per cell, mean fixed test error minus linear_bayes_floor lies in [-0.01, 0.03] (V7: -0.0004 at 0.6, +0.003 at 0.25, +0.020 at 1.0).

E_CONTROL.corrected_law: In the frozen world the cost inequality is deterministic and never favours MODEL (direct 805*r, model 550+1600*r), so the only non-tautological content is admissibility. The DIRECT route's normalized return per goal has mean 0.859 and sd 0.161 (pooled over the 344 protected V7 goals), so P(DIRECT admissible at reuse r) = Phi((0.859-0.80)/(0.161/sqrt(r))): 0.64, 0.70, 0.85, 0.98 at r = 1, 2, 8, 32 (V7 observed 5/8, 6/8, 7/8, 8/8). An admissibility-conditioned predictor names DIRECT only where all eight replicates are admissible with probability >= 0.95, i.e. r >= 48.

numbered_predictions.P-E4: DIRECT predicted-inadmissible in 0 to 4 of 8 replicates (law: 1.84 expected)
numbered_predictions.P-E5: mean direct normalized return over the 8 replicates in [0.77, 0.95]

E_CONTROL.kill_condition: P-E7: two or more predicted-inadmissible replicates across the 32 lane-cell replicates (law probability < 0.002) kills the concentration law.

development_seed_rule: int(SHA256('GMI-K5-BH-V8-DEV'||task_hash||SHA256(this plan file))[:16],16) mod 2^32; task_hash = SHA256(canonical JSON of {lane,parameter,value,replicate,kind,plan:SHA256(this plan file)}).
protected_seed_rule: int(SHA256('GMI-K5-BH-V8'||task_hash||verified_unique_drand_randomness)[:16],16) mod 2^32, only under a V8 execution freeze with its own no-reroll beacon receipt.
claim_ceiling: Synthetic held-regime revival evidence for two K5 lanes under the frozen V7 development budget and world generator. It does not reopen or weaken the protected V7 THEORY_RED and INCONCLUSIVE verdicts, does not exhibit a trainable-feature-wins regime, and does not test the MODEL side of the control law, which the frozen world cannot realise.
